question: What is the overall GSD compliance rate?
sql: SELECT MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`) AS gsd_rate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.gsd_compliance_metrics

question: Show the GSD compliance rate by age band.
sql: SELECT `Age Band`, MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`) AS rate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.gsd_compliance_metrics GROUP BY `Age Band` ORDER BY `Age Band`

question: Show the GSD compliance rate by clinic, worst first.
sql: SELECT `Clinic`, MEASURE(`Eligible Patients`) AS eligible, MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`) AS rate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.gsd_compliance_metrics GROUP BY `Clinic` ORDER BY rate ASC

question: What is the GSD poor glycemic control rate (A1c > 9)?

question: What is the KED compliance rate and its eGFR and uACR components?

question: Compare all six diabetes quality measure compliance rates.
sql: SELECT 'GSD' AS measure, MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`) AS rate FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.gsd_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'KED', MEASURE(`KED Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.ked_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'BPD', MEASURE(`BPD Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.bpd_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'SPD', MEASURE(`SPD Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.spd_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'EED', MEASURE(`EED Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.eed_compliance_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'SSD', MEASURE(`SSD Compliance Rate`) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_semantic.ssd_compliance_metrics ORDER BY measure

content: This agent answers questions about six HEDIS diabetes quality measures (HEDIS-aligned demo, not NCQA-certified): GSD, KED, BPD, SPD, EED, and SSD.
For measure RATES, query the matching metric view (gsd/ked/bpd/spd/eed/ssd_compliance_metrics) using MEASURE(`<measure name>`), e.g. MEASURE(`GSD Compliance Rate`). Never SUM or AVG a rate column.

Every compliance metric view has dimensions Measurement Year, Compliance Status, Clinic, Panel, Gap Reason, Age Band, Measure. To break a rate down by site, GROUP BY `Clinic`; to explain care gaps, GROUP BY `Gap Reason` (it shows 'Met' for compliant patients).
GSD = Glycemic Status Assessment: diabetics aged 18-75 with an A1c test in the measurement year. Also exposes Poor Control Rate (A1c > 9).
KED = Kidney Health Evaluation: diabetics aged 18-85 with BOTH an eGFR and a uACR test; uACR is usually the limiting component (see Gap Reason).
BPD = Blood Pressure control: diabetics aged 18-75 whose most recent BP reading is <140/90. Gap Reason distinguishes 'no reading' from 'not controlled'.
SPD = Statin Therapy: diabetics aged 40-75 dispensed a statin in the measurement year.
EED = Eye Exam: diabetics aged 18-75 with a retinal/diabetic eye exam in the measurement year.

SSD = Diabetes Screening for People on Antipsychotics: this is a SEPARATE cohort (serious mental illness + antipsychotic dispensing, ages 18-64), NOT the diabetes cohort. Numerator is a glucose or HbA1c screen.

For patient-level detail or care gaps, use gold_adherence_<measure>. The MET / NOT_MET rule lives in each metric view's Compliance Status dimension; over the gold tables a care gap is: GSD/SPD/EED evidence_datetime IS NULL, KED egfr_datetime IS NULL OR uacr_datetime IS NULL, BPD NOT (systolic < 140 AND diastolic < 90) or no reading. clinic_id / panel_id are on every gold table.
The diabetes cohort is defined by subsumption over the ICD-10-CM hierarchy (diagnoses under E10/E11/E13).

sql: COUNT_IF(gold_adherence_ked.egfr_datetime IS NOT NULL AND gold_adherence_ked.uacr_datetime IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*)

measures.display_name: GSD poor control rate (A1c > 9%, among tested)
GSD good control rate (A1c < 8%, among tested)

synonyms: diabetes screening rate for antipsychotic users

filters.display_name: SSD care gaps (no glucose or HbA1c screen)
GSD care gaps (no A1c test in the measurement year)
KED care gaps (missing eGFR and/or uACR)
sql: NOT (gold_adherence_ked.egfr_datetime IS NOT NULL AND gold_adherence_ked.uacr_datetime IS NOT NULL)
gold_adherence_ked.egfr_datetime IS NOT NULL AND gold_adherence_ked.uacr_datetime IS NULL

filters.display_name: EED care gaps (no diabetic eye exam)
BPD care gaps (uncontrolled or no reading)

expressions.display_name: BPD gap reason (matches the BPD metric view)
sql: CASE WHEN gold_adherence_bpd.systolic < 140 AND gold_adherence_bpd.diastolic < 90 THEN 'Met' WHEN gold_adherence_bpd.bp_datetime IS NULL THEN 'No BP reading in measurement year' ELSE 'BP not controlled (>=140/90)' END

CASE WHEN gold_adherence_gsd.evidence_datetime IS NULL THEN 'Not tested' WHEN gold_adherence_gsd.evidence_value < 8.0 THEN 'Good (<8%)' WHEN gold_adherence_gsd.evidence_value > 9.0 THEN 'Poor (>9%)' ELSE 'Moderate (8-9%)' END

expressions.display_name: KED gap reason (matches the KED metric view)
sql: CASE WHEN gold_adherence_ked.egfr_datetime IS NOT NULL AND gold_adherence_ked.uacr_datetime IS NOT NULL THEN 'Met' WHEN gold_adherence_ked.egfr_datetime IS NULL AND gold_adherence_ked.uacr_datetime IS NULL THEN 'No eGFR or uACR test' WHEN gold_adherence_ked.uacr_datetime IS NULL THEN 'Missing uACR' ELSE 'Missing eGFR' END

question: Patient 00f63646-fc2f-16a9-53e5-951816dfefe3 (MY2026): eligible for all five measures; open care gaps by each measure's live rule (the rules live in the metric views)

content:
SELECT array_join(array_sort(collect_list(m)), ',') AS open_gaps FROM (
  SELECT 'GSD' AS m FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_gsd WHERE patient_id = '00f63646-fc2f-16a9-53e5-951816dfefe3'
    AND measurement_year = 2026 AND eligible_flag AND evidence_datetime IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'KED' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_ked WHERE patient_id = '00f63646-fc2f-16a9-53e5-951816dfefe3'
    AND measurement_year = 2026 AND eligible_flag AND (egfr_datetime IS NULL OR uacr_datetime IS NULL)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'BPD' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_bpd WHERE patient_id = '00f63646-fc2f-16a9-53e5-951816dfefe3'
    AND measurement_year = 2026 AND eligible_flag AND NOT (systolic < 140 AND diastolic < 90)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'SPD' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_spd WHERE patient_id = '00f63646-fc2f-16a9-53e5-951816dfefe3'
    AND measurement_year = 2026 AND eligible_flag AND evidence_datetime IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'EED' FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_eed WHERE patient_id = '00f63646-fc2f-16a9-53e5-951816dfefe3'
    AND measurement_year = 2026 AND eligible_flag AND evidence_datetime IS NULL)

evaluation_note: Gold answer key graph_patient_gaps (hand-verified, MY2026). Expected value: EED,KED.

question: Overall GSD compliance rate = numerator / eligible

content:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN evidence_datetime IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / SUM(CASE WHEN eligible_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS gsd_rate
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.gold_adherence_gsd

evaluation_note: Gold answer key kpi_gsd_rate (hand-verified, MY2026). Expected value: 0.7424.
